reconciling twice: the second call finds a trusted marker and writes nothing, so the tree and bytes are identical
the gate cannot be asked: the inferred marker is not written
an unsafe bottle name is refused before any read
a bottle with no current_dxvk-macOS: the pinned marker is written without a dxvk field even though the engine has one
a bottle that has current_dxvk-macOS: the marker records the engine DXVK dir and version
the engine has no DXVK: no dxvk field even though the bottle has current_dxvk-macOS
SVC-02 idempotency: recording the same marker twice leaves identical bytes and an identical tree
SVC-02 idempotency: recording over a marker that already says the same leaves the bytes unchanged
a marker written by a newer build (version 2) is never overwritten: the call returns false and the bytes stay
an unreadable marker is writable (gate state unreadable): it is replaced by a valid one
a crossover marker is replaced by the pinned one
a marker with no version key reads as version 0 and is rewritten at version 1
a dxvk: "failed" marker is replaced by the recorded DXVK once the bottle has current_dxvk-macOS
a pin id no build ships is accepted as long as it matches the id grammar
a pin id with a separator fails the id grammar: false, nothing written, no gate call
a 65 character pin id fails the id grammar (1 to 64 characters)
the bottle directory does not exist: false and nothing is created
a bottle name with a separator is refused
Rust cannot be asked: the marker is not written
the gate answers newer for a bottle with no marker: the write is refused
only the directory is required: a marker is written into a bottle that is not yet a wine prefix
the crossover marker names the CrossOver wineserver under the given bin dir
SVC-02 idempotency: the same crossover marker twice leaves identical bytes
a pinned marker is replaced by the crossover one
a newer marker is never overwritten
no bottle directory: false
Rust cannot be asked: nothing is written
isBottleProvisioned is true only when <bottle>/cxbottle.conf exists: every fixture, an absent bottle and unsafe names

the predicate answers false for a name the sanitiser changes or rejects, so "..", the nested path and the self-referencing parent path never reach a path even with a conf there; "." is clean (the sanitiser keeps it, 87-11 finding 3) and reads false because no conf sits at the Bottles root; the TS recorded true for the other three (quick 261124-8f3, deltas.json provisioned-answers-false-for-an-unclean-name)
a wine prefix with system.reg and no conf: the minimal conf is written (0644, tmp then rename, BottleID uppercased)
SVC-02 idempotency: the second write finds the conf and leaves it untouched
an existing conf (a different BottleID) is never overwritten
no system.reg: not a wine prefix, nothing written
no bottle directory: false and nothing created
wineserver -k with WINEPREFIX set to the bottle, the extra env spread before it, the 15 s cap and an inherited base env
the run is cut by its timeout (code null): a warning and false
the spawn fails: never throws, a warning and false
separator, parent, empty, padded, NUL and "." names are refused with a warning and no process starts ("." is refused by the containment check, not the sanitiser)
WINEPREFIX is spread last: extra env cannot steer it away from the bottle
a bottle directly under the Bottles root is removed; a sibling bottle, a sibling directory of the root and a directory whose name starts with the root name are untouched
names that are not a single safe segment under the root are refused with a warning: a parent path, separators, "..", ".", empty, padded and a trailing slash; every directory survives
a bottle that is not there: rm with force is a no-op, no warning
a bottle that is a symlink: the link is removed and its target outside the root survives
cxbottle --create with the capped timeout and the abort signal; the bottle appears with a CrossOver conf; a best-effort wineserver -k with CX_ROOT follows
the create cap is the caller's createTimeoutMs
an already-provisioned bottle: cxbottle runs, createdHere is false, the bottle is untouched (SVC-02)
the create hits its cap (code null) leaving a partial bottle: a wineserver -k, then the bottle this call created is removed; errorCode crossover-create-timeout
cxbottle exits 1 and leaves a prefix with no conf: error crossover-create-failed, the partial bottle removed
the same failure on a directory that was already there: it is not removed (createdHere false)
cxbottle exits 0 and creates nothing: not provisioned, error crossover-create-failed
the spawn itself fails: error text carries the failure, the partial bottle removed
a name with a separator is refused before any spawn
a padded name is not the sanitised name: refused
the signal is already aborted: no cxbottle process, the kill and removal still run, errorCode provision-aborted
the signal aborts while cxbottle runs: the partial bottle is cleaned and the result is provision-aborted
wineboot -i (180 s cap, WINEDLLOVERRIDES=mshtml=, USER=crossover, WINEDEBUG=-all), wineserver -w (60 s), the DXVK installer through the fallback settings, the conf last, then wineserver -k
an engine with no DXVK: no installer call, the conf is written after the wait
a half-created bottle (system.reg, no conf) is completed: createdHere is false
SVC-02: running creation over a provisioned bottle never overwrites its conf, so the final conf write reports not written and the call fails without removing the bottle
wineboot exits non-zero: stderr in the error text, wineserver -k, the bottle this call created removed
wineboot fails on a bottle that was already there: the directory stays
the wineboot spawn fails: the error carries "fallback bottle creation threw"
wineserver -w is cut by its cap (code null): "wineserver -w timed out", cleaned
the DXVK installer returns false: "DXVK install failed", cleaned
the installer returns true but current_dxvk-macOS is absent: still a DXVK failure
the installer throws: caught and reported as "fallback bottle creation threw"
wineboot leaves no system.reg: the conf is not written and the call fails after the wait
the signal is already aborted: wineboot still starts, then the abort is noticed before the wait; provision-aborted
the signal aborts while wineboot runs: cancelled, cleaned
the signal aborts during the DXVK step: cancelled, cleaned (checked before the marker test)
a provisioned bottle is reused: engine existing, createdHere false, no process starts, nothing changes (SVC-02)
the decision is CrossOver with a bin dir: cxbottle --create with the decision cap
SVC-02: ensuring the same bottle twice creates it once and reuses it the second time; the tree after the second call equals the first
the decision is the pinned engine: ensurePin, then the fallback creation
CrossOver decided but no bin dir resolves: the current pin creates the bottle
cxbottle fails to produce a conf: a warning and the current pin creates the bottle
the pin cannot be made available: engine-download-failed with the download error
the download is cancelled: provision-aborted, not a download failure
a cancelled CrossOver create is final: provision-aborted, no fallback creation
an unsafe name returns an error before the flight starts
two callers at once share one flight: one cxbottle process, equal results
a Steam title keys the flight by its bare app id
markGameRunning records a key per bottle; gamesRunningIn and otherGamesRunning exclude nothing or the caller; markGameStopped drops the empty bottle (size)
an unsafe bottle name or a key that is not an engine key is refused (false) and never recorded; queries on an unsafe name are empty
a crossover and a pinned selection are stored per engine key; get returns what was stored, a later set replaces it, clear removes it and a repeat clear is harmless
a non-CrossOver selection whose wine or wineserver is not on disk is refused (false) and never stored
a key that is not an engine key is refused for every selection kind: not a number, a prefixed steam id, an unknown runner, a path
the stored selection is a copy: changing the input object (and its dxvk) after set does not change what get returns
a legacy effective engine launches exactly as before, whatever the settings
a CrossOver game keeps the bottle it names (per-game, legacy, padded or unsafe falls back to GameLib)
a non-CrossOver game whose stored bottle is its per-game name stays on it
a plain-prefix game switched to Automatic or CrossOver gets a fresh per-game bottle and reports the old prefix
any other override keeps the plain prefix
an unknown runner or an unclean app name is invalid
